entries.html: /copy — native clipboard write path for Linux X11 sessions
Ctrl-C while subagents are running now interrupts only the subagents, instead of exiting the whole CLI
/sessions — Ctrl-X then y deletes the selected session from the picker
kimi upgrade / kimi update — -y, --yes skips the confirmation prompt and installs directly
loop_control.compaction_max_attempts — caps total attempts for a failing compaction request; default 5
KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER env var — set to 0 to stop injecting auto permission-mode reminders into the model context
Ctrl-S — a steering message can now interrupt a wait for a background task
/goal — the time budget no longer counts time spent with the session closed, and the 24-hour limit is removed
card-keys — initial reference: the seven keyboard-shortcut contexts, from general input to the approval panel (19 rows)
card-slash-core — initial reference: account, session, mode and status commands with their aliases (33 rows)
card-slash-tools — initial reference: swarm and goal control, extensibility, and the built-in skill commands (16 rows)
card-cli — initial reference: all 14 top-level flags and all 12 subcommands (25 rows)
card-settings — initial reference: config.toml, tui.toml and .kimi-code/local.toml (37 rows)
card-env — initial reference: core paths, model overrides, runtime switches and diagnostics (22 rows)
card-skills — initial reference: skill and agent directories, the four AGENTS.md locations, plugins (18 rows)
card-hooks — initial reference: 18 hook events, hook exit codes, mcp.json and MCP permissions (20 rows)
KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_REMOTE_CONTROL and KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_SECONDARY_MODEL — Remote Control and the subagent model pool are always on in 0.42.0, so both flags were removed
[database] replaces the experimental minidb flags; the read model and search worker are now controlled by KIMI_CODE_PERSISTENCE_MINIDB_READMODEL and KIMI_CODE_SEARCH_WORKER
[read] — configurable character limits and resumable long-line file reads, replacing repeated output truncation
Ctrl-O — finished tool calls collapse to a header plus one outcome row; hidden output is counted and revealed here
